title: A plugin kernel for mini-dsh
brief: Write a tiny Cordis-like kernel in mini-dsh/src/kernel.ts and rebuild mini-dsh on it. The kernel has a Context with a prototype chain and a symbol-keyed service store, fibers with six states, effects whose disposers run in reverse, inject lists that keep a plugin pending, four event modes plus a waterfall, isolate realms and agent scopes. Then move the DeepSeek adapter, the tools and the agent loop out of main.ts into three plugins, list them as config rows in a profile, and make a saved patch remount only the row it changed. When you finish, no file imports another part directly: every part reads what it needs from the context, so a test or a second model can replace any one of them from a patch file.

starter.note: New. Context (extend, get, provide, effect, plugin, isolate, on, emit, parallel, serial, bail, waterfall), Fiber and createScope.
Existing DeepSeek adapter. Wrap it in mini-dsh/plugins/deepseek.ts, which provides llm and sends each request through the llm/request waterfall.
Existing tool functions. Wrap them in mini-dsh/plugins/tools.ts, which provides tools with register(def) and list(scope).
Existing agent loop. Wrap it in mini-dsh/plugins/loop.ts with inject: ['llm', 'tools']; it reads both from ctx and imports neither file.
New. loadRows, applyPatches, composeProfile and reload (compare rows by id). Uses the yaml package.
New. Lists bundles/core; patch.yml beside it holds your own patches.
New. Tests for the kernel with a fake adapter; no network.

hints: Start with extend and the store. Write a test that a child reads the root's service through the prototype and that a child's own property never appears on the root.
Make provide, on and plugin all go through effect, so there is one place where disposers are recorded. Then dispose only has to run fiber.disposers in reverse.

refresh is the heart of inject: call it on every fiber after any provide and after any provide disposer. A pending fiber that is ready starts; an active fiber that is not ready unloads and goes back to pending.
In waterfall, copy the listener list before you shift from it, and give each listener its own next with a called flag, so calling next twice throws.
For reload, a row changed if JSON.stringify of the old and new row differ. Dispose that fiber and mount the row again; leave fibers of unchanged ids alone.

rubric.criterion: Context.extend uses Object.create, a child reads the root's services, and a child's own properties never reach the parent
ctx.plugin returns a Fiber that moves pending, loading, active (or failed with the error kept), unloading, disposed, and a disposed fiber never restarts
provide, on and plugin are effects; disposing a fiber runs its disposers in reverse and disposes child fibers
A plugin with inject stays pending until every named service exists, unloads when one leaves, and loads again when it returns, in any mount order
emit, parallel, serial and bail behave as taught; serial and bail stop at the first value that is not null, false or undefined
waterfall passes next as the last argument, a listener that skips next replaces the result, and calling next twice throws
ctx.isolate(name) lets a subtree provide its own service under a taken name, while the parent and other names are unchanged
createScope tags a child context; tools and listeners registered through it reach that agent only, and untagged ones reach every agent
The plugin tree is a YAML list of rows, and applyPatches inserts rows or replaces whole keys of one row by id
composeProfile applies bundles, then the profile patch, then a command-line patch over an empty list; reload remounts only changed rows

milestones.title: Context, fibers and disposers
milestones.body: Write Context.extend, get, provide, effect and plugin, and the Fiber states. A test mounts a plugin that provides llm and starts a timer, disposes it, and checks that the timer stopped before llm left the store.

milestones.title: Services that plugins wait for
milestones.body: Add inject and refresh. Mount the loop plugin before a fake adapter, check that it is pending, then active, then pending again after the adapter is disposed, and active with a second fake adapter.

milestones.title: Events and the waterfall
milestones.body: Add on, emit, parallel, serial, bail and waterfall. Route every model request through llm/request and add a budget listener that refuses max_tokens above 8192 without calling next.

milestones.title: Realms and agent scopes
milestones.body: Add isolate and createScope. Run a coder and a reviewer agent with fake adapters: the coder's apply_edit tool and counter listener must not reach the reviewer, and an isolated llm must not change the root's.

milestones.title: mini-dsh from a profile
milestones.body: Move the adapter, tools and loop into plugins, list them in bundles/core/rows.yml, and start mini-dsh from profiles/agent. Saving patch.yml with a new max_tokens remounts only the llm row.
